title: Semi-Slav Defense: Meran Variation
line: Black takes on c4 and pushes the queenside pawns forward, chasing the bishop.

steps.text: The Queen's Gambit, and Black guards the center pawn with the pawn on c6.
Black adds the king pawn: the Semi-Slav. White moves its king pawn one square.
Bring the other knight out behind the pawns. It backs up later pawn pushes.
Take the pawn on c4 now that White's bishop has moved. The bishop spends a second move to take back.
Push the pawn on b7 two squares. It chases the bishop and takes space.
Bring the bishop out to the long diagonal. It waits behind the pawn on c6 until that pawn moves.
Move the pawn on a7 one square. It backs up the pawn on b5 and gets ready for the next push.
steps.after: White takes the center with its king pawn.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c6 one square. It strikes at White's center from the side and opens the diagonal of your bishop.
steps.after: Black has space on the queenside and pressure on the center.

summary: Black takes the side pawn, chases the bishop with the queenside pawns, then strikes at the center from the side.
